local_acceptance_proxy.self_report: At least one assistant step contains the frozen success-language proxy.
local_acceptance_proxy.successful_commands: At least three environment actions have return code 0.
local_acceptance_proxy.admission: Both conditions are required. External benchmark correctness remains blinded.
local_acceptance_proxy.catastrophic_output_rule: A 0/37 output with fewer than three successful commands is rejected and must not appear in downstream prompts.

frozen_expectation: All zero-command catastrophic outputs are rejected. Future intermittent failures remain possible because accepted successful histories still grow.
recipient_blinding: Every admitted generated reference replaces external scores with the local completion-and-smoke proxy label.
